scripts.build: rm -rf out && mkdir -p out && tsc && for f in out/*.js; do mv "$f" "${f%.js}.gs"; done && cp src/appsscript.json src/styles.html src/index.html src/style-css.html src/layout.html src/app-js.html out/ && sed -i '' "s/0\.0\.0-dev/$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")/g" out/main.gs
scripts.build:gas: rm -rf out && mkdir -p out && tsc -p tsconfig.gas.json && for f in out/*.js; do mv "$f" "${f%.js}.gs"; done && cp src/appsscript.gas.json out/appsscript.json && cp src/styles.html src/index.html src/style-css.html src/layout.html src/app-js.html out/ && sed -i '' "s/0\.0\.0-dev/$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")/g" out/main.gs
scripts.push: npm run build && npx clasp push --force
scripts.deploy: npm run push && npx clasp version "v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && NEWVER=$(npx clasp versions 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '^[0-9]+' | sort -n | tail -1) && npx clasp deploy --deploymentId AKfycbyVkxEjiFyV4kzMd8cZADsjmHUlAN-DgSRb2errioqNHi3k3r4abUSbrr_JD_6wQIyh --versionNumber $NEWVER --description "v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && PREVVER=$((NEWVER-1)) && echo '' && echo '⚠️  MANUAL STEP: bump Sheets Add-on Script Version from '"$PREVVER"' to '"$NEWVER"' at:' && echo -n 'https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/api/appsmarket-component.googleapis.com/overview?project=am-gsheet2json' | pbcopy && echo 'https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/api/appsmarket-component.googleapis.com/overview?project=am-gsheet2json' && echo '(URL copied to clipboard)'
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx/esm' cucumber-js --tags 'not @gas and not @pre-submit'
scripts.test:gas: npm run build:gas && npx clasp push --force && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx/esm' cucumber-js --tags @gas
scripts.test:all: npm run test:pre-submit && npm run test:gas && npm run build
scripts.record:promo: echo 'Open Claude Code and paste: scripts/record-session.md'
